name: HB-2 external full-grid launch
purpose: Remove the smoke expansion caps from LFS, ToT, and RAP, add sharded budget-exhaustive full-grid launchers, validate launcher semantics on a tiny budget, and start the formal n=64 external no-train baseline grid. This is a launch/progress item only; it records that the full-grid batch is running and does not read HB-2 outcomes.

provenance.launch_command: BASELINES=lfs,tot_rap,best_of_n SHARDS=8 GPUS=8 INSTANCES=64 TASKS=sudoku,futoshiki,graph_color BUDGET_SCALES=0.25,0.5,1,2,4 scripts/launch_hb2_external_full_grid.sh

code_added_used.change: max_expansions=0 now means run until budget, goal, or no frontier; added run-shard/merge/budget-scales/resume support.
max_expansions=0, mcts_iters=0, max_depth=0, and rollout_depth=0 remove smoke caps for budget-exhaustive ToT/RAP; added run-shard/merge/budget-scales/resume support.
Sequential master launcher for lfs, tot_rap, and best_of_n with 8-shard resumeable full-grid execution.

headline.cap_removal: LFS/ToT/RAP now support zero expansion/iteration/depth smoke caps for budget-exhaustive runs; positive caps remain available only as smoke/safety parameters.
headline.launcher_dry_run: best-of-n, LFS, and ToT/RAP launchers completed a one-instance low-budget merge dry run.
headline.formal_launch: The formal n=64 full grid is running in terminal 9e3667fc-064f-4651-b232-81b25a04ffc1; LFS started at 2026-06-15T13:40:55Z.
headline.single_next_move: Monitor shard checkpoints and merge outputs; create HB-2 closeout only after full-grid merged JSONs exist.

gate_outcomes.number: LFS max_expansions=0; ToT/RAP max_expansions=0, mcts_iters=0, max_depth=0, rollout_depth=0 mean no artificial smoke cap.
Low-budget dry run stopped with BUDGET_EXHAUSTED instead of EXPANSION_CAP when no cap was set.
n=64 x 3 tasks x 5 budget scales launched with 8 shards; ToT/RAP includes both methods.
No full-grid merged result is complete yet; zero scientific conclusion is drawn from this item.

decision.next_step_routing: Wait for full-grid merged outputs, then compute/read solve@budget against A_cache symbolic and A_cache_C1. Do not confirm or kill HB-2 before merged results exist.

honesty.does_not_establish: This item does not contain HB-2 results and does not compare solve rates. It only records cap removal, launcher validation, and the start of the full-grid run.
honesty.scope_limit: The formal run is still in progress. Any partial shard rows are progress telemetry, not final evidence.
honesty.conclusion_policy: Only merged full-grid outputs may be used for HB-2 confirm/kill. Until then the conclusion remains zero-read.
honesty.runtime_note: Futoshiki budgets are large, especially at 2x/4x B*, so the run may be long and should be resumed from checkpoints if interrupted.
